findings.description: Removing the seen-set guard makes the __cause__ walk loop forever if the exception chain contains a cycle.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception whose __cause__ chain loops back on itself, e.g. e1.__cause__ = e2 and e2.__cause__ = e1, is raised from a retried function. Mechanism: the while loop now has only the None check as its exit, so it follows the cycle indefinitely without ever reaching a cause that matches. Impact: the retry predicate hangs the thread instead of returning, which the previous cycle detection prevented.
